options.label: Mainland lash tech, Yaba. ₦15k.
options.receipt: You went to a ₦15k lash tech in Yaba.

outcomes.text: Honestly? Fire. Mainland excellence. The fan blew one lash off and she glued it back for free.
NEPA took light halfway. She finished by phone torch. You'll see the damage tomorrow.

options.label: Awolowo Road facial and lashes. ₦80k.
options.receipt: You booked an ₦80k facial on Awolowo Road.

outcomes.text: Marble, cucumber water, a woman who calls you 'my dear' in a whisper. You glow.
A reaction. Your face is having opinions. Tomorrow will be interesting.

options.label: Full glow-up package. ₦250k.
options.receipt: You spent ₦250k on a full glow-up.

outcomes.text: Skin, lashes, brows, a hair appointment you didn't know you needed. Strangers open doors for you.
Glowing, but the brow tech went rogue. One brow is surprised. Permanently.

name: Bestie on Speed Dial
blurb: Free. Sanity, advice, and occasionally terrible ideas.

outcomes.text: She listens, gasps in the right places, and says 'you deserve better' four times.

options.label: "What have you heard about {partner}?"
options.receipt: You asked your Bestie for gist about {partner}.

outcomes.text: She lowers her voice even though you're on the phone.

options.label: "Help me plan something petty."
options.receipt: You let your toxic Bestie plan something petty.

outcomes.text: She has a whole PowerPoint. Slide 3 is titled 'EXPOSE HIM'. You feel powerful and slightly unwell.

options.label: "Tell me the truth, even if it hurts."
options.receipt: You asked your Bestie for the hard truth.

outcomes.text: 'You keep explaining things he never explained.' Silence. She's right. She's always right.

name: Amebo Network
blurb: ₦30k for one tell. Gist cuts both ways.

options.label: Buy one tell about {partner}. ₦30k.
options.receipt: You paid the Amebo Network for gist.

outcomes.text: The Amebo sends a voice note in a whisper. She's eating something crunchy.
You get your gist. Then the Amebo sells some of yours.

options.label: Plant a rumour about yourself. ₦30k.
options.receipt: You paid the Amebo to plant a rumour about you.

outcomes.text: By evening, Lekki thinks you're dating a footballer. {Partner} suddenly texts more.
The rumour mutates. Now you're dating a pastor. Who is married.

name: Therapist / Deliverance
blurb: ₦40k. Heal it, name it, or pray it away.

outcomes.text: She asks 'and how did that make you feel?' and you cry for 40 minutes. Worth every naira.

options.label: "Name what he's doing to me." ₦40k.
options.receipt: You asked your therapist to name the pattern.

outcomes.text: She draws a triangle on her notepad. 'Triangulation. Intermittent reward. Control.' Now you have words. Words are weapons.

options.label: Deliverance: pastor prays for the relationship. ₦40k.
options.receipt: You paid a pastor to pray for the relationship.

outcomes.text: He prays with his whole chest. By evening {partner} calls, softer than usual. Coincidence? Sure.
The pastor squints: 'Brother {partner}? He's a member here.' Lagos is a village with traffic.

options.label: VIP booth on Ozumba Mbadiwe. ₦80k.
options.receipt: You booked a VIP booth on a night out.

outcomes.text: Sparklers, a DJ shout-out, and a stranger named Tunde who 'just wants to talk'.
You spot {partner} two booths away. With company. {He} sees you see {him}.

good_one.text: Sparklers, a DJ shout-out, and a stranger named Tunde who 'just wants to talk'.
{Partner} is there with business people. {He} waves you over and introduces you as 'my person'.

options.label: Just the dance floor. ₦20k at the door.
options.receipt: You hit the dance floor without a booth.

outcomes.text: No booth, no sparklers, pure vibes. Your feet will file a complaint.
